technical.title: GATS uses LiDAR geometry to select image tokens for efficient autonomous driving
technical.summary: Geometry-Aware Token Selection (GATS) uses LiDAR and radar point projections to select a small fraction of relevant image tokens before the vision backbone runs, improving efficiency and removing irrelevant visual clutter for planners.
technical.why: This directly optimizes vision-centric autonomous driving pipelines by reducing compute overhead and eliminating noisy tokens.

technical.title: SOMA benchmark evaluates fine-grained human body motion understanding in MLLMs
technical.summary: SOMA is a new benchmark featuring 1,632 human-verified questions designed to evaluate MLLMs on fine-grained egocentric body-motion understanding, focusing on body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning.
technical.why: It provides a robust way to assess multimodal models on complex egocentric human motion tasks.

technical.title: SimpleLoRIF traces and filters safety degradation in instruction fine-tuning data
technical.summary: SimpleLoRIF uses a scalable gradient embedding method restricted to the final transformer blocks to identify fine-tuning instruction data that quietly degrades model safety, enabling practical filtering of million-scale datasets.
technical.why: It gives you a practical engineering tool to audit and clean post-training datasets for hidden safety issues.

technical.title: TinyAstral transfers self-improving harnesses to compact manipulation agents
technical.summary: TinyAstral uses recursive self-improvement on a teacher model's harness to generate optimized tools and recovery logic, transferring these improvements into a smaller, low-compute generalist manipulation agent.
technical.why: It provides a blueprint for distilling advanced agent harnesses into efficient, compact robotics models.

technical.title: CalibSwitch provides observation-driven camera-LiDAR extrinsic recovery and maintenance
technical.summary: CalibSwitch is an observation-driven framework for mobile robots and autonomous vehicles that separates absolute extrinsic recovery from selective state maintenance, ensuring reliable camera-LiDAR sensor geometry during operation.
technical.why: It addresses critical calibration drift issues in multimodal robotic perception systems.

technical.title: DMAT models observation-conditioned joint-space action chunks for bimanual manipulation
technical.summary: The Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT) bypasses iterative denoising or numerical integration in diffusion policies by directly modeling clean, observation-conditioned action chunks in a structured joint-action space.
technical.why: It reduces execution latency and mismatch in visuomotor policies for robotic manipulation.

technical.title: DeepSeek open-sources dsh-superagent router-worker coding agent
technical.summary: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions, reducing p95 task completion times in simulations.
technical.why: It gives software engineers a look at efficient parallelized agent architectures for coding workloads.

technical.title: GEPA-Curator improves prompt optimization by selecting effective agent experiences
technical.summary: GEPA-Curator is a new framework that enhances reflective prompt optimizers by carefully selecting which agent execution experiences provide useful learning signals, avoiding noisy or harmful task failures during prompt optimization.
technical.why: It offers a cleaner methodology for improving multi-turn agentic workloads through targeted experience curation.

technical.title: Drone-PUR benchmark measures vision-language reasoning in UAV scenes
technical.summary: Drone-PUR introduces a dataset and benchmark organized around visual clue discovery, interpretation, and integration to evaluate vision-language models on perception, understanding, and reasoning in challenging UAV environments.
technical.why: It helps rigorously test VLM performance under small targets, changing viewpoints, and complex aerial conditions.

technical.title: Multi-agent engineering assistant built with Amazon Nova and Bedrock
technical.summary: Learn how to build a multi-agent engineering assistant that evaluates aerospace component substitutions using Amazon Nova Multimodal Embeddings, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and the Strands Agents SDK.
technical.why: It demonstrates practical multi-agent design patterns for enterprise multimodal engineering workflows.

business.title: South Korea targets sovereign AI model with record budget
business.summary: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, including a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.
business.why: Government spending heavily influences regional hardware demand and autonomous driving research investments.

business.title: Nvidia weighs cosigning loan for Nscale data center
business.summary: Nvidia is considering playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia as investors grow nervous about AI spending.
business.why: Chipmaker financing strategies reveal how physical AI infrastructure bottlenecks are being directly managed.

business.title: Apple plans $1,000 home robot for FaceTime and lights
business.summary: Backed by CEO John Ternus, Apple's upcoming home robot may launch in 2027 with a hefty price tag and limited uses.
business.why: Consumer hardware robotics releases indicate commercial viability and consumer robotics market strategies.

business.title: Omen AI acquires Aquatic Labs for $16 million
business.summary: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal, combining liquid know-how.
business.why: Data center infrastructure costs and cooling solutions directly impact physical AI hardware scaling.

business.title: Venture capital funding concentrates heavily in massive AI rounds
business.summary: Record venture funding in 2026 has been increasingly concentrated in massive AI rounds, while seed- and early-stage deal counts are on the decline.
business.why: Understanding venture capital allocation trends helps engineers anticipate industry market movements and startup viability.

business.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants with Grid Protectors
business.summary: OpenAI will pilot its Grid Protectors Program at a Georgia data center, promising to free up to 1,000 megawatts of power during emergencies.
business.why: Power availability constraints directly limit the scale of future computer vision and training clusters.

business.title: New York Times sues Brave web browser over scraping
business.summary: The New York Times and other publications filed lawsuits against Brave over alleged unlawful AI training scraping and paywall bypassing.
business.why: Scraping legality impacts data acquisition strategies for foundation model training and computer vision datasets.

business.title: AI coding agents consume significantly more tokens than basic prompts
business.summary: When developers give AI agents coding tasks, iterative planning and testing uses 10 to 50 times more tokens than basic chat prompts.
business.why: Token consumption economics heavily influence infrastructure costs for automated code generation tools.

business.title: OpenAI signs four Abu Dhabi agreements with Sam Altman
business.summary: OpenAI signed four Abu Dhabi agreements spanning energy, government and investment as Sam Altman met the emirate’s crown prince.
business.why: Major international investments shape the global compute and capital landscape for AI infrastructure.

business.title: Companies report AI revenue boosts and cost cuts
business.summary: Santander, Novartis and other companies say AI is beginning to boost revenue, cut costs or improve profitability as investors seek returns.
business.why: Enterprise adoption trends dictate overall industry market stability and software engineering priorities.

models.title: Speridlabs Introduces Idol for Single-Image 3D Gaussian Splatting
models.summary: Idol converts a single picture, render, or generated image into a 3D Gaussian splat with up to 1,048,576 Gaussians. It runs on consumer GPUs using 7.2 GB of VRAM in under 2 seconds.
models.why: It significantly accelerates 3D reconstruction from a single photo on consumer hardware.

models.title: Mistral AI Announces Mistral Large 4 Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Model
models.summary: Mistral Large 4 is a 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model featuring 49 billion active parameters per token, fluent in 160+ languages and excelling in visual grounding.
models.why: It offers state-of-the-art capabilities in multimodal understanding and visual grounding.

models.title: CCORE Releases Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder for Interactive 3D Scenes
models.summary: Qwen3.5-4B-3D-Coder is an independent fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B focusing on general coding and generating interactive 3D scenes with Three.js.
models.why: It demonstrates the feasibility of small language models for specialized 3D scene generation tasks.

models.title: LiquidAI Releases LFM3-1.7B Text Model for Local Agents
models.summary: LFM3-1.7B is a text model built on a tri-hybrid architecture with a 256K-token context window. Designed for edge devices, it consumes about 1 GB of memory at 4-bit precision and supports single-GPU fine-tuning.
models.why: It provides a lightweight option for running local agentic workflows on edge hardware.

models.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited OCR 2 for Long-Horizon Document Parsing
models.summary: Unlimited OCR 2 pioneers the OCR-3.0 era by achieving unlimited-horizon parsing with SR-SWA, accompanied by the MarathonDocBench benchmark for ultra-long documents.
models.why: It expands document parsing capabilities to handle ultra-long horizons effectively.

models.title: Pika-Labs Releases Pika H3 Flex for Professional Video Iteration
models.summary: Pika H3 Flex is a post-trained H3 video generation model featuring six-step generation, omni-reference support for up to 12 inputs, and synchronized audio.
models.why: It provides professional creators with precise control over video and audio generation workflows.
